verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs say typo tolerance is provided out of the box and can be customized to control how tolerant search should be (algolia-docs-7, algolia-docs-45). A hands-on user independently praises its typo acceptance as a standout feature (algolia-comm-16). One user wished fuzzy matching could be turned off for HN search (algolia-comm-14), but that concerns one deployment's configuration and does not contradict the documented controls. Missing for 10: specific documentation of the tuning controls (e.g. per-attribute disabling, word-length thresholds, typo count limits), and evidence of how fuzzy matching interacts with ranking rules.
